{{Top|leg}}
'''Healing''' was an [[Ee mental power]], and part of the physical skills category. Ee skilled in this power could heal injuries in other Ee, as well as non-Ee. However, when the target to be healed was a non-Ee, it was harder for the Ee to heal them.
